specs.Compatible Devices: Compatible with All New Kindle 11th Generation 2022 Release

features: This transparent TPU back case cover is specially designed for 6 Inch All New Kindle (11th Generation) - 2022 Release, the latest version, NOT FIT Kindle Paperwhite or Kindle Oasis!!!
The clear case is made of durable TPU material, it's slim soft, lightweight, flexible and scratch-resistant, won't add bulk to your device
This protective case is designed with impact resistant thick corners to effectively protect your device from drops and bumps
Ultra transparent to let the world see your new kindle, you can decorate it with stickers to change the back view
Easy to install and remove without scratching your device
description: This clear back case cover ONLY fits the latest 2022 Release 6 Inch All New Kindle 11th Generation, it does NOT fit Kindle Paperwhite or Kindle Oasis!!! The transparent case is made of high quality TPU, which is slim, soft, durable, lightweight and flexible. With reinforced corners, it can protect your device from scratching and bumping, it provides excellant protection against shocks, scratches and dust. Crystal clear back features which looks fashionable while allowing you to see your Kindle's attractive design, and you can decorate it with stickers when mood strikes you. Precise cutouts allow easy access to all ports, sensors, speakers, cameras and all features.
